frequency_question: How often do executive principals successfully finalize their priority agency-level administrative rulemakings within a comparable timeframe when they possess clear jurisdiction and intent?
membership_rule: Includes major agency-level rulemakings initiated by cabinet secretaries or agency heads under clear statutory authority where the administration's leadership explicitly signaled intent. Excludes purely legislative actions or matters requiring congressional appropriations.

cases.name: EPA Waters of the United States Repeal (Trump 1st)
EPA Clean Power Plan Repeal / ACE Rule (Trump 1st)
State Dept Public Charge Visa Guidance (Trump 1st)

coverage_note: 8 named major rulemakings pushed through by dedicated agency leadership; all successfully reached final rule publication stage.
known_gaps: Does not account for subsequent judicial injunctions, which belong to an excluded aperture.
validity_reason: Applies to the duration of the current executive administration term.
